latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Editor for YouTube — first release

- Edit raw video footage into polished 1080p YouTube videos using AI, supporting MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB.
- Connects automatically to a cloud backend with easy setup; 100 free credits included for new users.
- Offers automated edits like trimming dead air, transitions, and auto-generated captions, with processing times of 1–2 minutes per video.
- Exports finished videos as MP4 for YouTube, with detailed error handling and session management built in.
- Accepts direct uploads and prompt-based instructions, with full support for batch processing and iterative editing workflows.
